Twin Tusk Arrow [20.]
Woodcarver's Tools
Common
Supplies: 1
1/8 Day Focused
With counter-spiraling tusks, the arrow drives deep into flesh and chitin both.
When Crafting Twin Tusk Arrows, you create 6 arrows
Piercing Tusks When a Twin Tusk Arrow successfully hits a creature, the unique 
twinned corkscrew shape of the tusks rent open flesh and armor alike. For every 
arrow embedded in the target, lower the target creature's Armor Class by 1, up to 
a maximum of 3. All embedded arrows can be removed as an Action, requiring 
the target to make a Medicine check or a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Success: 
The arrow is removed, and the target takes 1 Piercing damage for each Twin Tusk 
Arrow pulled free.

Nulltouch Arrows
Woodcarver's Tools
Common

1/8 Day Focused
When struck, one may think themselves already dead as their body begins to numb with cold.
When crafting Nulltouch Arrow, you create 6 arrows
Numbing Strike When a Nulltouch Arrow successfully hits a creature, neurotoxin 
floods the creatures bloodstream. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, target creature. 
Failure: 4 (1d8) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition for one hour. The 
creature can repeat the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the 
effect on itself with a successful save. If a creature poisoned in this way fails 3 
consecutive Constitution Saving Throws against this effect they also have the 
Paralyzed condition until the Poison condition ends.

Black Mist Bomb [19.]
Alchemist's Supplies
Uncommon
Supplies: 1
1/4 Day Focused
The quiet blooming darkness is only broken by the screams of its burning victims.
Black Mist Burn As an Action, you can throw the bomb at a point up to 40 ft. 
away. On impact it explodes and instantly creates a 5 ft. radius Sphere of black 
acidic mist centered on that point for 5 minutes. Every minute the cloud expands 
another 5 ft. to a maximum radius of a 25 ft. Sphere. Constitution Saving Throw: 
DC 15, each creature within the mist, repeat the saving throw at the beginning 
of their turn if they are still in the mist. Failure: 2d6 Acid damage and has the 
Blinded condition. Success: Half damage.

The clear oily substance ignites with rapid ease, only burning brighter when doused.
As an Action, you can throw a pot of smold at a point up to 40 ft. away. Dexterity 
Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within a 20 ft. Sphere of the thrown pot. Failure: 
5d6 fire damage and begins burning for 4 minutes as the substance clings to 
them. Target creature takes 1d6 Fire damage at the start of their turn, a creature 
can smother the flames by using its Action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to 
extinguish the flames. Using water to extinguish the flames only exasperates it, 
dealing another 2d6 Fire damage and restarting the 4 minutes before it dies down.

Tool and weapon differences blur when slaying and digging graves in the same night.
When attacking with the Dredgemen's Edge, you can choose to use the edge 
(Slashing) or the flat face of the shovel (Bludgeoning).
Pitch As an Action, you can make a special melee attack to dig up loose soil and 
fling at a point up 15 ft. away. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature within 
5 ft. of the point. Failure: Target creature has the Blinded condition until the end 
of their next turn.
Quick Digger You can use the Shovel to dig out a 5 ft cubic cube of earth or similar 
material after working for 30 minutes. This time can be halved, but the wielder 
suffers 1 level of Exhaustion from the strain.

Swirling sparkling liquid within the glass promises a wild chemical reaction when lit.
Spreading Darkness As an Action, you can throw a Billow Pitch Pot at a point up 
to 40 ft. away. On impact it explodes and instantly creates a 10 ft. radius Sphere 
of thick black ink from that point for 4 minutes, or until dispersed by a strong 
wind. Additionally this cloud of ink can appear underwater and remains for 16 
minutes until dispersed by water currents. The cloud counts as heavily obscured 
and creatures within the cloud have the Blinded condition. Each creature within 
the cloud gets coated in a thin layer of black ink and must use an Action to scrape 
off the ink.

Underpyre Pot
Alchemist Supplies
Common
Supplies: 1
1/4 Day Focused
While lethal when lit, the sticky substance is a nightmare to handle as it clings to everything.
Clinging Burn As an Action, you can throw an underpyre pot at a point up to 40 ft. 
away. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within 20 ft. of the thrown pot. 
Failure: 2d4 Acid damage and begin searing for 4 minutes as the substance sticks 
to them. A searing creature takes 1d4 Acid damage at the start of their turn, halves 
their movement and suffers Disadvantage on Dexterity rolls as the sticky burning 
mass clings to all surfaces. A creature may spend an action to wipe the substance 
off themselves, another creature, an object or a 5 ft. surface area by making a DC 
15 Dexterity Save to end the effect.
